mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent ( agent_id, display_name, role_description, capabilities, tools ) VALUES ( #{agentId}, #{displayName}, #{role}, #{capabilities, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{tools, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.StringListJsonTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = VALUES(display_name), role_description = VALUES(role_description), capabilities = VALUES(capabilities), tools = VALUES(tools)
mapper.select: SELECT agent_id, display_name, role_description, capabilities, tools FROM agent ORDER BY agent_id ASC
